title_primary: 象牙之价：治理与政策如何塑造非法野生动物市场
title_secondary: The Price of a Horn: How Governance and Policy Shape an Illegal Wildlife Market
authors: Dang Vu Hoai Nam, Frank Jensen, Martin Reinhardt Nielsen
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Understanding the determinants of illegal rhino horn prices can provide information for the design of policies to conserve wild rhinoceroses. Using a theoretical model, we identify empirical measures that may affect illegal rhino horn prices and derive testable hypotheses about their expected effects. We test these hypotheses using time series data on actual illegal market prices of rhino horn in Vietnam. The price data were collected from consumers who purchased rhino horn in Vietnam between 2001 and 2020. Assuming that the illegal rhino horn markets in China and Vietnam are perfectly integrated, we examine the effects of various regulatory measures implemented in both countries. We find that China's legalisation of trade in rhino horn antiques and the implementation of an anti‐corruption campaign are associated with significant reductions in illegal rhino horn price in Vietnam, whereas Vietnam's increased sanctions on the rhino horn trade and use have no significant effects. These findings suggest that, in addition to wildlife‐specific policies, broader institutional reforms and governance crackdowns in China may substantially affect illegal rhino horn prices in Vietnam.

abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method

abstract: 当前中国经济正面临“内卷式”竞争加剧与全要素生产率增速放缓并存的结构性矛盾。为此,本文构建包含分步式创新与内生策略选择的熊彼特增长模型,结合典型事实,刻画企业在高质量创新、低质量微创新与掠夺性定价间的权衡,并通过数值模拟考察微观策略偏离导致宏观增长放缓的内在机理。研究发现,激烈的同质化竞争、缺乏梯度的产权保护与数量导向型的支持政策共同扭曲了创新激励,促使企业转向低成本微创新或价格战,挤出颠覆性技术突破,最终导致经济陷入高投入、低产出的“内卷陷阱”。拓展分析表明,信息不对称引发的信号混淆与内生劳动努力下降显著固化了该陷阱。本文的研究为通过质量导向型产业支持政策、差异化产权保护及结构性改革打破内卷提供理论支撑。

title: The price impact of Canadian retaliatory tariffs
title_zh: 加拿大报复性关税的价格影响
title_primary: 加拿大报复性关税的价格影响
title_secondary: The price impact of Canadian retaliatory tariffs
authors: Alberto Cavallo, Olena Kostyshyna, Oleksiy Kryvtsov, Matías Vieyra
official: 官方在线 2026-07-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How do import tariffs affect retail prices? We combine daily product-level posted prices from seven major Canadian retailers with product-level tariff exposure to estimate tariff effects in a difference-in-differences framework. Prices of tariffed goods rose gradually, peaking at 6% after three months, implying pass-through of roughly one quarter of the 25% tariff. We find little spillover to untariffed substitutes and a rapid reversal of price effects after tariff removal. Adjustment occurred mainly through the frequency of price changes. Pass-through shifted with trade-policy news and was larger for products labeled “Tariffed”, showing that tariff-induced inflation depends on policy expectations and tariff salience.
abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响零售价格？我们整合了加拿大七家主要零售商的每日产品层面标价数据与产品层面的关税暴露程度，在双重差分框架下估算关税效应。受关税影响商品的价格逐步上升，三个月后达到6%的峰值，这意味着约四分之一的25%关税被传导至价格。我们未发现对未征税替代品产生显著溢出效应，且关税取消后价格效应迅速逆转。价格调整主要通过调价频率实现。传导效应随贸易政策新闻动态变化，且对标注"征税"标签的产品更为显著，这表明关税引发的通胀取决于政策预期与关税显著性。

title: Public debt and monetary policy transmission: evidence from advanced and emerging Europe
title_zh: 公共债务与货币政策传导：来自发达与新兴欧洲的证据
title_primary: 公共债务与货币政策传导：来自发达与新兴欧洲的证据
title_secondary: Public debt and monetary policy transmission: evidence from advanced and emerging Europe
authors: Christopher Johns, Aaron Mehrotra, Fabrizio Zampolli
official: 官方在线 2026-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Focus In standard models of monetary policy, public debt is assumed to have no role. Policy rate changes affect output and inflation through conventional channels, and any fiscal consequences of interest rate changes are assumed to be offset by corresponding adjustments in fiscal policy. However, with public debt high in many economies, this assumption may no longer be innocuous. Changes in monetary policy affect not only private borrowing costs but also government interest payments, the income earned by government bondholders and the market value of outstanding public debt. The impact depends on the size of the debt stock, which magnifies these effects, and the maturity profile, which determines how quickly higher policy rates pass through to debt service costs and interest income. It also depends on the sensitivity of bond values to changes in yields.
abstract_zh: 在标准货币政策模型中，公共债务通常被假定为不发挥作用。政策利率变动通过传统渠道影响产出和通胀，而利率变动的任何财政后果均被假定可通过财政政策的相应调整予以抵消。然而，鉴于许多经济体的公共债务水平高企，这一假设可能不再无关紧要。货币政策变动不仅影响私人借贷成本，还会影响政府利息支出、国债持有人获得的收入以及未偿公共债务的市场价值。其影响程度取决于债务存量规模（该规模会放大这些效应）以及期限结构（该结构决定政策利率上升在多大程度上传导至偿债成本和利息收入），同时还取决于债券价值对收益率变动的敏感度。

title: Competing under Information Heterogeneity: Evidence from Auto Insurance
title_zh: 信息异质性下的竞争：来自汽车保险的证据
title_primary: 信息异质性下的竞争：来自汽车保险的证据
title_secondary: Competing under Information Heterogeneity: Evidence from Auto Insurance
authors: Marco Cosconati, Yi Xin, Fan Wu, Yizhou Jin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies competition under information heterogeneity in selection markets and examines the impact of public information regulations aimed at reducing information asymmetries between competing firms. We develop a novel model and introduce new empirical strategies to analyze imperfect competition in markets where firms have heterogeneous information about consumers, vary in cost structures, and offer differentiated products. Using data from the Italian auto insurance market, we find substantial differences in the precision of risk ratings across insurers, and those with less accurate risk-rating algorithms tend to have more efficient cost structures. We assess the equilibrium effects of giving firms equal access to aggregated risk information from a centralized bureau. This policy significantly reduces prices by increasing competition, leading to a 15.7% boost in consumer surplus, almost reaching the efficiency benchmark where firms have full knowledge of consumers’ true risk. Aggregating information through the bureau favors low-risk consumers and reduces average costs by 12 euros per contract through more efficient insurer-insuree matching.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在选择性市场中信息异质性下的竞争问题，并探讨了旨在减少竞争企业间信息不对称的公共信息监管政策的影响。我们构建了一个新颖的模型，并引入了新的实证策略，以分析企业在消费者信息掌握程度、成本结构差异及产品差异化方面存在异质性的不完全竞争市场。利用意大利汽车保险市场的数据，我们发现不同保险公司的风险评级精度存在显著差异，而风险评级算法精度较低的公司往往拥有更高效的成本结构。我们评估了赋予企业平等获取中央机构汇总风险信息这一政策的均衡效应。该政策通过增强竞争显著降低了价格，使消费者剩余提升15.7%，几乎达到企业完全掌握消费者真实风险时的效率基准。通过中央机构汇总信息有利于低风险消费者，并通过更高效的保险公司与投保人匹配，使每份合同平均成本降低12欧元。

title: When the money stops: fiscal and political reactions to changing grant eligibility
title_zh: 当资金停止：对拨款资格变化的财政与政治反应
title_primary: 当资金停止：对拨款资格变化的财政与政治反应
title_secondary: When the money stops: fiscal and political reactions to changing grant eligibility
authors: Touria Jaaidane, Sophie Larribeau
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the incentive effects of vertical equalization transfers in France. Using a reform in 2017 that tightened eligibility criteria for an equalization grant, we analyze how grant losses affect municipal budget choices. Drawing on a large panel of urban municipalities covering the 2014–2024 period, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences framework to identify the causal impact of grant losses. We first show that, on average, municipalities substitute grants with local tax revenues. Second, political factors reveal heterogeneity in responses. Left-wing municipalities increase spending and simultaneously raise taxes and debt. In contrast, right-wing municipalities increase taxes but consolidate debt. Municipalities led by narrowly elected mayors pursue stronger fiscal discipline, reducing expenditures and debt. Political fragmentation within municipal councils generates patterns consistent with coalition bargaining.

title: The Impact of Income Subsidies on Maize Harvest Losses: Evidence From Chinese Farmers
title_zh: 收入补贴对玉米收获损失的影响：来自中国农户的证据
title_primary: 收入补贴对玉米收获损失的影响：来自中国农户的证据
title_secondary: The Impact of Income Subsidies on Maize Harvest Losses: Evidence From Chinese Farmers
authors: Xue Qu, Yi Luo, Yonghao Hu, Laping Wu
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: With the increasing risk of global food insecurity, countries have accelerated their efforts to reduce food loss and waste. Moreover, traditional agricultural policies, such as income subsidies, significantly impact farmers' behaviour and grain production and likely food losses. Based on survey data from 1885 maize growers in China, we measured maize harvest losses in China and empirically analysed the impact of income subsidies on such losses. The results showed that on average, 3.02% of the total maize amount was lost at the harvest stage, and the loss per unit area was 17.5 kg/mu (262.5 kg/ha). Income subsidies were significantly correlated with greater maize harvest losses, and this conclusion remained robust after potential endogeneity problems were resolved. A heterogeneity analysis revealed that the impact of income subsidies on maize harvest losses was significant for small‐scale farmers but not for large‐scale farmers. We suggest that the Chinese government should accelerate the transformation of agri‐food systems and the reform of income subsidy policies, which should encourage farmers to increase the scale of their operations, and these subsidies should be transformed into more targeted policies to meet the requirements for reducing food losses.
abstract_zh: 随着全球粮食不安全风险的加剧，各国纷纷加快减少粮食损失与浪费的步伐。此外，传统农业政策（如收入补贴）显著影响农户行为及粮食生产，并可能加剧粮食损失。基于中国1885户玉米种植户的调查数据，我们测算了中国玉米收获环节的损失，并实证分析了收入补贴对这类损失的影响。结果表明，玉米在收获阶段的平均损失占总产量的3.02%，单位面积损失为17.5公斤/亩（262.5公斤/公顷）。收入补贴与玉米收获损失显著正相关，且在解决潜在内生性问题后，这一结论依然稳健。异质性分析显示，收入补贴对玉米收获损失的影响在小规模农户中显著，但对大规模农户不显著。我们建议中国政府加速农业食品体系转型及收入补贴政策改革，鼓励农户扩大经营规模，并将补贴转化为更具针对性的政策，以满足减少粮食损失的要求。

title: How Nurture Activates Nature in Determining Savings Behavior: Evidence from China’s Send-Down Movement and Twins Data
title_zh: 后天如何激发先天以决定储蓄行为：来自中国上山下乡运动与双胞胎数据的证据
title_primary: 后天如何激发先天以决定储蓄行为：来自中国上山下乡运动与双胞胎数据的证据
title_secondary: How Nurture Activates Nature in Determining Savings Behavior: Evidence from China’s Send-Down Movement and Twins Data
authors: Wenchao Li, Junjian Yi, Junsen Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Savings behavior is governed by innate predispositions (nature) and environmental conditions (nurture); yet prior research largely examines these forces in isolation. Leveraging China’s send-down movement—a policy shock that exposed urban youths to adversity—and a twins design exploiting genetic differences between monozygotic and dizygotic pairs, we identify nature-nurture interplay. Applying extended twin-based variance components models to representative data, we find that adversity more than triples genetic influence on savings, increasing its variance share from 15.2 percent among the unexposed to 53.4 percent among the exposed. Results challenge conventional fixed-effects models which assume time-invariant unobserved traits (e.g., genetic endowments) exert linearly additive effects, and demonstrate policy effectiveness hinges on interactions with such traits.
abstract_zh: 储蓄行为受先天禀赋（天性）与后天环境（教养）共同支配，然而既有研究多将二者割裂分析。本研究借助中国"上山下乡"运动——一项使城市青年暴露于逆境的政策冲击——结合双胞胎设计（利用同卵与异卵双胞胎的遗传差异），识别天性-教养的交互作用。通过将扩展的双胞胎方差成分模型应用于代表性数据，我们发现逆境使储蓄行为的遗传影响提升逾两倍，其方差占比从未经历逆境群体的15.2%跃升至经历逆境群体的53.4%。该结果挑战了传统固定效应模型（该模型假设未观测特质如遗传禀赋呈线性可加效应），并证明政策有效性取决于其与这类特质的交互作用。

title: The Golden Age of Al‐Andalus? Living standards in Muslim Iberia (950–1200)
title_zh: 安达卢斯的黄金时代？穆斯林伊比利亚的生活水平（950–1200）
title_primary: 安达卢斯的黄金时代？穆斯林伊比利亚的生活水平（950–1200）
title_secondary: The Golden Age of Al‐Andalus? Living standards in Muslim Iberia (950–1200)
authors: António Henriques
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article provides the first systematic estimates of living standards in Al‐Andalus (the Muslim‐ruled Iberian Peninsula) in 950, 1000, and 1200. Drawing on prices and wages from legal documents and market regulation treatises, it reconstructs real wages and welfare ratios. The results indicate that living standards in Al‐Andalus during the tenth century were high in both absolute and comparative terms. Unskilled workers in Córdoba around 950 and 1000 attained welfare ratios comparable to those observed in Fatimid Egypt and the poorer parts of Europe before the nineteenth century. By 1200, real wages declined, particularly for skilled labour, reflecting rising prices and stagnant nominal wages. These findings are robust to alternative basket assumptions and are consistent with independent qualitative and quantitative evidence on welfare levels, urbanization, monetary capacity, and aggregate output. The article contributes to debates on the timing of the Great Divergence by documenting another episode of high living standards under non‐Western institutions.
abstract_zh: 本文首次系统估算了安达卢斯（穆斯林统治下的伊比利亚半岛）在公元950年、1000年和1200年的生活水平。基于法律文献和市场管理论著中的价格与工资数据，本文重建了实际工资与福利比率。结果表明，10世纪安达卢斯的生活水平在绝对和比较意义上均处于高位。公元950年和1000年前后，科尔多瓦的非熟练工人所获得的福利比率，与法蒂玛王朝时期的埃及以及19世纪前欧洲较贫困地区相当。到1200年，实际工资出现下降，尤其是熟练劳动力，这反映了物价上涨与名义工资停滞。这些发现在替代性消费篮子假设下依然稳健，并与关于福利水平、城市化、货币能力及总产出的独立定性与定量证据一致。本文通过记录非西方制度下另一个高生活水平的案例，为关于“大分流”时间节点的讨论提供了新证据。

title: Can energy transition strengthen tax revenue mobilization in developing countries? Empirical evidence and policy implications
title_zh: 能源转型能否增强发展中国家的税收动员能力？实证证据与政策启示
title_primary: 能源转型能否增强发展中国家的税收动员能力？实证证据与政策启示
title_secondary: Can energy transition strengthen tax revenue mobilization in developing countries? Empirical evidence and policy implications
authors: Atangana Ondoa Henri, Ngobo Philibert Junior
official: 官方在线 2026-05-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether the energy transition supports tax revenue mobilization in developing countries. Using a newly constructed Multidimensional Energy Development Index and a panel of 52 developing economies over the period 2000–2019, we analyze the relationship between the energy transition and tax revenue aggregates—including total, direct, indirect, and trade taxes—as well as fiscal effort. Results show a statistically significant and economically meaningful positive relationship between the energy transition and all tax revenue components. Further analysis suggests that this relationship operates through improved energy access, higher economic activity, productivity gains, and enhanced human development. These findings challenge concerns about potential fiscal burdens associated with the energy transition, indicating that green energy–oriented policies can strengthen fiscal sustainability in low- and middle-income countries and support inclusive energy and environmental tax reforms. Finally, we propose policy recommendations aimed at helping decision-makers in these countries reconcile environmental and budgetary challenges.

title: Consumption in Asset Returns
title_zh: 资产收益中的消费
title_primary: 资产收益中的消费
title_secondary: Consumption in Asset Returns
authors: SVETLANA BRYZGALOVA, JIANTAO HUANG, CHRISTIAN JULLIARD
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using information in returns, we identify the stochastic process of consumption. We find that aggregate consumption reacts over multiple quarters to innovations spanned by financial markets. This persistent component accounts for over a quarter of consumption variation. These shocks command a large and significant risk premium, driving a large share of stocks' and a small yet significant fraction of bonds' time‐series variation. Nevertheless, we find no support for stochastic volatility of consumption driving time‐varying risk premia. Finally, an otherwise standard recursive utility model based on our estimated process explains equity premium and risk‐free rate puzzles with low‐risk aversion.
abstract_zh: 利用收益率中的信息，我们识别了消费的随机过程。研究发现，总体消费对金融市场所涵盖的冲击会持续多个季度作出反应。这一持久性成分解释了超过四分之一的消费波动。这些冲击具有显著且规模较大的风险溢价，驱动了股票时间序列变化的主要部分以及债券时间序列变化中虽小但显著的部分。然而，我们并未发现消费的随机波动性驱动时变风险溢价的证据。最后，基于我们估计过程的递归效用模型（在其他方面均为标准设定）在低风险厌恶水平下解释了股权溢价和无风险利率之谜。

title: The potential of Carbon Border Adjustments to foster climate cooperation
title_zh: 碳边境调整促进气候合作的潜力
title_primary: 碳边境调整促进气候合作的潜力
title_secondary: The potential of Carbon Border Adjustments to foster climate cooperation
authors: Timothé Beaufils, Joschka Wanner, Leonie Wenz
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The European Union (EU) is implementing a Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) at its borders, which will require exporters of basic materials to surrender emission permits when exporting to the EU market. Since it makes foreign producers compete under a carbon price, the EU CBAM may motivate some trade partners to implement their own carbon pricing mechanisms, thereby encouraging the creation of a coalition of countries with ambitious carbon pricing policies protected by a joint CBAM. Such geostrategic potential of the EU CBAM has been identified in previous literature, but the conditions under which it could be realised remain largely unknown. Here, we present a modelling framework to simulate the potential of CBAMs to motivate the creation of climate coalitions. We use a fully interlinked New Quantitative Trade model to evaluate the pay-offs of a dynamic club negotiation model. Compared to previous research, our approach allows for a more granular definition of climate policies and requires relatively little input data and numerical power. This allows us to explore the formation and stability of climate coalitions under a broader range of CBAM implementation options. Our results highlight that the potential of a CBAM-based climate coalition strongly depends on the exact CBAM design. In its current version, the EU CBAM would only trigger the formation of a modest coalition. Future extensions of the EU CBAM could motivate the adoption of carbon pricing in all countries except China, India and Russia. Meanwhile, export rebates shrink its coalition-building potential.

title: Flexible Contract, Flexible Morale? Microcredit Design and Repayment Discipline
title_zh: 灵活合同，灵活道德？小额信贷设计与还款纪律
title_primary: 灵活合同，灵活道德？小额信贷设计与还款纪律
title_secondary: Flexible Contract, Flexible Morale? Microcredit Design and Repayment Discipline
authors: Kristina Czura, Anett John, Lisa Spantig
official: 官方在线 2026-01-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Flexible repayment benefits borrowers, but practitioners fear increased moral hazard. Investigating their concerns requires disentangling repayment choices from repayment capacity, which is typically infeasible in field studies. We use a lab-in-the-field experiment with 645 microcredit borrowers to cleanly identify the effect of repayment flexibility on moral hazard. We also quantify social pressure. Payoff maximization predicts low repayment in our rigid benchmark contract, and increased repayment with flexibility. Results suggest the opposite: Repayment in the rigid contract is high, and drops substantially under flexible repayment. Social pressure decreases. Our results are consistent with a strong social norm for repayment, which is weakened by introducing flexibility. Norms, which may be inculcated by the lender, may help explain several recent puzzles in microfinance research, including high and equal repayment rates across individual- and joint-liability contracts, and excessive peer pressure. Importantly, norm-driven behavior may erode with the introduction of flexibility.

title: Buyers' response to third‐party quality certification: Theory and evidence from Ethiopian wheat traders
title_zh: 买方对第三方质量认证的反应：来自埃塞俄比亚小麦交易商的理论与证据
title_primary: 买方对第三方质量认证的反应：来自埃塞俄比亚小麦交易商的理论与证据
title_secondary: Buyers' response to third‐party quality certification: Theory and evidence from Ethiopian wheat traders
authors: Gashaw T. Abate, Tanguy Bernard, Erwin Bulte, Jérémy Do Nascimento Miguel, Elisabeth Sadoulet
official: 官方在线 2025-10-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: When quality attributes of a product are not directly observable, third-party certification (TPC) enables buyers to distinguish between quality levels and reward sellers accordingly. We study the adoption of TPC by traders in smallholder-based agricultural value chains in low-income countries, where traders aggregate products from many small-scale producers before selling in bulk to downstream processors. In this context, the introduction of TPC services has oftentimes failed. We develop a theoretical model identifying how different market conditions affect traders' choice to purchase certified output from farmers. Next, using a novel lab-in-the-field experiment with Ethiopian wheat traders, we examine the model's predictions. Traders’ willingness to specialize in certified output increases with the share of certified wheat in the market, and this effect is stronger in larger markets. However, we find that traders do not optimally respond to variation in the quality of uncertified wheat in the market. We also analyze conditions where traders deviate from optimal behavior and discuss implications for research and policy making to promote TPC in smallholder-based value-chains.

title: Investing in Human Capital During Wartime: Experimental Evidence from Ukraine
title_zh: 战时人力资本投资：来自乌克兰的实验证据
title_primary: 战时人力资本投资：来自乌克兰的实验证据
title_secondary: Investing in Human Capital During Wartime: Experimental Evidence from Ukraine
authors: Lelys Dinarte-Diaz, James Gresham, Renata Lemos, Harry A. Patrinos, Rony Rodriguez-Ramirez
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides insights into human capital investments during wartime by presenting evidence from three experiments of an online tutoring program for Ukrainian students amid Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. Conducted between early 2023 and mid-2024, the experiments reached nearly 10,000 students across all regions of Ukraine. The program offered three hours per week of small-group tutoring in math and Ukrainian language over six weeks, and used academic and psychosocial tools to address student challenges at different intensities of disruption. We find that the program led to substantial improvements in learning — up to 0.49 standard deviations in math and 0.40 standard deviations in Ukrainian language — and consistent reductions in stress — up to 0.12 standard deviations. We document high take-up and engagement, and identify four mechanisms driving impact: structured peer interactions, improved attitudes toward learning, enhanced socio-emotional skills, and increased student investments. A complementary experiment using information nudges to increase parental engagement highlights challenges in promoting parental investments in a conflict setting. The program was cost-effective across all experiments, with benefit-to-cost ratios ranging from 31 to 56, and scalable given its reliance on existing infrastructure and teaching capacity.
abstract_zh: 本文通过展示俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间针对乌克兰学生开展的在线辅导项目的三项实验证据，揭示了战时人力资本投资的深层机制。实验于2023年初至2024年中实施，覆盖乌克兰全境近万名学子。该项目每周提供三小时、为期六周的小组辅导（数学与乌克兰语），并运用学术与心理社会工具应对不同强度干扰下的学生困境。研究发现：该项目显著提升学业表现——数学成绩最高提升0.49个标准差，乌克兰语成绩最高提升0.40个标准差——同时持续降低压力水平（最高降幅达0.12个标准差）。我们观察到高参与度与投入度，并识别出四种作用机制：结构化同伴互动、学习态度改善、社会情感能力增强及学生自主投入提升。通过信息助推提升家长参与的补充实验，揭示了冲突情境下促进家长投入面临的挑战。所有实验均显示项目具有成本效益，效益成本比介于31至56之间，且依托现有基础设施与教学能力具备可扩展性。

title: Lives, livelihoods, and learning: A global perspective on the well-being impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic
title_zh: 生命、生计与学习：新冠疫情对福祉影响的全球视角
title_primary: 生命、生计与学习：新冠疫情对福祉影响的全球视角
title_secondary: Lives, livelihoods, and learning: A global perspective on the well-being impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic
authors: Benoit Decerf, Jed Friedman, Arthur Mendes, Steven Pennings, N. Yonzan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-03-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study develops a common framework to compare the magnitude of national level losses that the COVID-19 pandemic inflicted across three critical dimensions — loss of life, loss of income, and loss of learning — and then explores the global distribution of such losses. To help inform public discussions, the well-being consequences of excess mortality are expressed in years of life lost, while those of income losses and school closures are expressed in additional person-years spent in poverty, either currently or in the future (due to lower growth). While 2020–2021 witnessed a global drop in life expectancy and the largest one-year increase in global poverty in many decades, widespread school closures may cause almost twice as large an increase in future poverty. The estimates of well-being loss for the average global citizen include a loss of 8 days of life, an additional two and half weeks spent in poverty in 2020 and 2021 (17 days), and the possibility of an additional month of life in poverty in the future due to school closures (31 days). The distribution of pandemic costs was highly unequal globally. While aggregating total losses requires the valuation of a year of life lost vis-à-vis an additional year spent in poverty, high-income countries experienced the lowest well-being losses for a wide range of valuations. Aggregate losses were much higher among lower-income countries, especially countries in the Latin America region who suffered the largest mortality costs as well as large losses in learning and sharp increases in poverty.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个统一框架，用以比较新冠疫情在国家层面造成的三重关键维度损失——生命损失、收入损失与学习损失——并进一步探讨此类损失的全球分布格局。为助力公共讨论，超额死亡带来的福祉影响以生命损失年数衡量，而收入损失与学校关闭的后果则通过当前或未来（因增长放缓）新增的贫困人年数呈现。尽管2020-2021年间全球预期寿命下降，且全球贫困人口出现数十年来最大单年增幅，但大规模学校关闭可能使未来贫困人口增幅达到前者的近两倍。全球普通公民的福祉损失估算包括：生命损失8天、2020-2021年额外贫困时间两周半（17天），以及因学校关闭可能导致的未来额外贫困时间一个月（31天）。疫情成本的全球分布极不均衡。尽管汇总总损失需对生命损失年与新增贫困年进行价值权衡，但在广泛的价值评估区间内，高收入国家的福祉损失始终最低。中低收入国家的总损失显著更高，尤以拉丁美洲地区为甚——该地区不仅承受了最高的死亡率成本，还面临严重的学习损失与贫困率急剧攀升。
